Cambium Gigabit Radio PoE Power Injector 30V 15W – Reliable Power for High-Performance Wireless Networks

Enhance your wireless connectivity with the Cambium Gigabit Radio PoE Power Injector, delivering stable and efficient power to your Cambium Networks devices. Operating at 30V with 15W output, this compact and durable injector is designed to support Gigabit Ethernet speeds, ensuring minimal latency and high data throughput for your radio systems.

Perfect for outdoor and enterprise-grade wireless deployments, this PoE injector simplifies installation by combining power and data over a single Ethernet cable—ideal for ePMP, cnPilot, and cnWave solutions. Built to Cambium’s rigorous standards, it ensures consistent power delivery, overvoltage protection, and energy efficiency in demanding environments.


Key Features:

  • Input: 100-240V AC | Output: 30V DC, 15W
  • Supports Gigabit Ethernet for high-speed connectivity
  • Compatible with Cambium ePMP, cnPilot, and other devices
  • Simplifies installations by delivering data and power over a single cable
  • Compact, plug-and-play design with built-in protection features
